notes: s007's *in that* was taken as one rendering of the preposition under rule 30's one-rendering reading and rule 52; the alternative was to head it on *in*, which the note records.

s024 is the resumptive object suffix of the relative clause: two morphemes point at the antecedent and the ASV writes one word, so the relative takes *whom* and the suffix is unrepresented under rule 22.
